title: Backlog item
description: One backlog item without a team: the content of one item file, as decided by the owner on 2026-11-13. Required: the title and the description a person gives, and what the CLI supplies at creation. Every other property is optional and set with backlog update. The code does not yet write this shape (it writes name for title and body for description, and more fields at creation).

seq.description: The item's number in this repository, never reused. Supplied by the CLI at creation.

slug.description: The number and the title in file-name form; the name an item is addressed by in every command. Supplied by the CLI at creation.

title.description: A short title of the item. Given by the person: backlog new --title; changed with backlog update --title.

team.description: The team that owns the item. Absent for an item without a team; an item that has it takes its fields from its team's item definition instead of the fields below. Set by: backlog team new, a rule of the team, backlog team migrate.

repository.description: The repository the item belongs to. Supplied by the CLI at creation.

branch.description: The branch the item belongs to. Supplied by the CLI at creation; changed with backlog move.

created.description: When the item was created. Supplied by the CLI.

updated.description: When the item last changed. Supplied by the CLI on every change.

updated_by.description: Who changed the item last: the agent named for the command, else the user of the configuration. Supplied by the CLI on every change.

fields.description: The values of the item. Only status is required; the CLI writes it at creation. Every other field is absent until backlog update sets it. A key not listed here is kept as it is.

status.description: Where the item is, one word. The default item definition has at least the words new, active and closed; a team's item definition may declare its own. Supplied by the CLI at creation as the first word (new); changed with backlog update <item> status <word>.

objective.description: The result the item delivers, one line. Set by: backlog update --objective.

summary.description: Several sentences about what the item is for; it routes new work to the right item. Set by: backlog update --summary.

location.description: Free text: where the work is. Set by: backlog update --location.

commit.description: The commit the work has reached. Set by: backlog update --commit.

severity.description: A critical item is placed first. Set by: backlog update --severity.

owner.description: The agent working on the item; outside a team, the user the item belongs to. Set by: backlog update --claim and --release.

owned_since.description: When the agent took the item; empty while nobody holds it. Set by: the CLI, when the item is claimed.

depends_on.description: The items that must be finished first. Set by: backlog update --set-depends-on.

parent.description: The item this one was split from. Set by: backlog update --parent.

estimate_min.description: Minutes of work, a whole number. Set by: backlog update --set-estimate.

complexity.description: low, medium or high. Set by: backlog update --set-complexity.

layer.description: 1 to 5 or process. Set by: backlog update --set-layer.

chunk.description: Small pieces of work any member does between items. Set by: backlog update --set-chunk.

size_score.description: A whole number that sizes the item. Set by: backlog update --size_score.

completed.description: When the item was closed. Set by: the CLI, when the item is closed.

description.description: What the item is about, in markdown, and the records appended to it. Given by the person: backlog new --description; changed with backlog update --description, --append and --section.

history.description: One entry per command that changed the item.

session.description: The session id, or the empty text.

step.description: The command, or the step of a team's rules.

changes.description: One key per changed field, holding the value before and the value after.
